boundaries: The provider transport is explicitly synthetic and returns original harmless text; no real model endpoint, account, billing, tool execution or full standard preset is exercised.

Official SystemPrompt, ToolRuntime, AgentLoop, SessionController, subagent runtime, spawn, sessions, projection, storage and JSONL persistence use inventory-matching entries. This is an entry inventory check, not an audit of every transitive dependency or publisher signature.
System-slot role isolation is verified separately. Workflow also includes role content in the user task message; this evidence does not claim role text occurs exclusively in the system slot.
flow.release releases only the concurrency slot. Role assignment persists until assign(null); normal Workflow completion preserves closed child metadata. A new child does not inherit that assignment.
Role injection depends on globally applied controls and settings.enabled=true. The unchanged disabled/reverted behavior is preserved; reversion removes the runtime role injection wrapper.
Synthetic functional section registration proves retained assembly behavior; it is not a connected MCP execution or a complete shipped preset acceptance.
No real profile, real session, desktop configuration, DNS, network endpoint or subprocess is used by the acceptance fixture. Hashes contain no official prompt bodies, installation paths or secrets.
